name: UGC 6138 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 6138, a massive low surface brightness galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc06138-hubble
story: This faint, diffuse galaxy spreads its light thinly across the sky. Hubble searched it for globular clusters, whose presence or absence can reveal how such galaxies formed and evolved.

claims.text: UGC 6138 is one of six massive low surface brightness (LSB) galaxies targeted by program 10550
The program studies the galaxies' globular clusters to constrain how LSB galaxies formed and evolved
